To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) stereoscopic FPV is better than monoscopic FPV, (ii) stereoscopic FPVs are not as good as real life experiences, (iii) motion sickness can be reduced by reducing the field of view, (iv) motion sickness can also be reduced by increasing the frame rate, and (v) motion sickness can not be reduced by increasing image resolution.
1) VR HMD with stereoscopic vision improves depth perception and teleoperation accuracy; and 2) motion sickness is reduced when users are allowed to move their heads freely.
